description.value:
Energy Regeneration score +2. An ally's Ultimate heals the lowest-HP-percentage ally for 3 HP, once per round. Your healing grants its recipient attack bonus +1 per stack, maximum 3, for 2 turns.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching abundance Path required.
